note: Known axe-core findings per component. Regenerate with `npm run a11y:baseline` after fixing or accepting a finding.

knownIssues.why: The Base UI popover trigger renders as `<input role="button">`; ARIA in HTML does not allow the button role on a text input.
knownIssues.next: Trigger the popover from a real `<button>` that contains the read-only display value, then verify with a browser pass.

knownIssues.why: The closable-tabs demo puts the "Add tab" button inside `role="tablist"`, which must only contain tabs.
knownIssues.next: Move the add control outside `TabsList` and re-check the visual grouping.

knownIssues.why: Each demo tab nests its close `<button>` inside `role="tab"`, so a screen reader meets an interactive control inside an interactive control.
knownIssues.next: Move the close control next to the tab inside a `role="presentation"` wrapper and confirm keyboard order in a browser.
